the combination of antifungals in oil in water (o/w) emulsions is an effective alternative to control the fungal growth in strawberry jams, reducing the essential oil amount needed.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the combination of antifungals in emulsions is an effective alternative to control the mould spoilage in strawberry jams, minimizes the amount of essential oils needed to control the spoilage and preserves the sensory profile of the product.

the combination of different antimicrobial agents in oil in aqueous emulsions could be a good alternative to control fungal growth in strawberry jam, reducing the use of essential oils and the sensory impact in the final product.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of different antifungals agents in oil in-water emulsions could be used to control the fungal growth of strawberry jams.
it is possible to reduce the concentration of essential oil in emulsions, without losing their antimicrobial properties, using the combination of different antifungals.

it is possible to reduce the amount (up to 25% in some cases) of essential oil needed in the emulsion formulation by combining it with other natural antifungal agents, such as zinc gluconate, trans ferulic or benzoic acid, maintaining the hygienc quality of the strawberry jam and its organoleptic characteristics.
